title: Intent-based scaling orchestrator for dedicated fleets
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Create an intent-driven autoscaling orchestrator for dedicated GPU fleets that maps high-level business intents (throughput guarantees, tail-latency SLOs, and cost caps) into a composable target metric and safe scaling actions. The orchestrator should: 1) accept intent types from the Console/Policy DSL, 2) compute per-fleet composite targets (throughput/latency/cost), 3) pick a discrete scaling action using a model predictive controller (MPC) + corrective backoff, and 4) maintain a safety envelope (headroom credits, emergency floor, slew limits) to avoid oscillation and uncontrolled surge costs.
acceptance_criteria: API to accept intent payloads from Console and return computed scale recommendation in <250ms
Controller respects configured cost cap and will not recommend scale that breaches monthly committed cost forecasts
No regression in 95th-tail latency for synthetic load tests under controlled surge scenarios
Safety envelope prevents >2 unwanted instance allocations in 10 minutes during noisy metric conditions
E2E tests and canary on a single dedicated cluster show graceful fallback to lower-capacity model variant when capacity unavailable
design_notes: We avoid purely reactive PID designs because they either overshoot or oscillate under bursty LLM traffic. The orchestrator computes a short horizon forecast (30s-2min) using exponential smoothing + simple AR(1) to predict request token-rate. MPC then scores candidate scale actions against a composite loss: latency violation risk + incremental cost + instability penalty. Safety envelope includes: a tokenized headroom credit bank per-tenant, a global emergency floor set by SRE, and per-cluster max slew rates. Policies are authorable in the Policy DSL and UI will show projected cost impact for each intent.
implementation_plan: Week 1: Define intent schema and add REST endpoint; wire Console -> Policy DSL to send intents
Week 2: Implement short-horizon predictor and composite target calculator; unit tests + synthetic traffic generator
Week 3: Implement MPC evaluator with discrete-scale actions and safety envelope enforcement
Week 4: Integrate with autoscaler actuator (scale up/down RPCs) and add rollback + cooldown logic
Week 5: Canary on staging dedicated cluster; telemetry and traces; iterate on thresholds
Week 6: Gradual rollout to one production SPOG cluster; monitor cost & latency; prepare runbook
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal-only dedicated cluster for SRE validation (2 days)
Canary: single customer-mapped cluster with debug logging enabled (1 week)
Staged: 10% of newly provisioned dedicated clusters (3 weeks)
General: enable by default after 6 weeks if SLOs stable
test_plan: Unit tests for intent schema and composite target math
Synthetic burst tests: 1s-60s surge patterns to validate headroom consumption and refill behavior
Chaos test: delayed scale actions and flapping controller inputs to verify dewobble logic
Cost guardrail test: simulated cost forecast boundary crossing to validate action blocking
A/B canary: compare controller vs current autoscaler on latency/cost curves
metrics: Committed vs actual monthly cost delta per fleet
